items.title: Omar Cooper: Making return to practice Wednesday
items.text:
The Jets designated Cooper (ankle) for return from injured reserve Wednesday, Antwan V. Staley of the New York Daily News reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Breece Hall: Not practicing, still week-to-week
items.text:
Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Hall (quadriceps) won't practice Wednesday and remains week-to-week, Al Iannazzone of Newsday reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Adonai Mitchell: Undergoes hand procedure, still week-to-week
items.text:
Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Wednesday that Mitchell (finger) underwent a small procedure on his hand and remains week-to-week, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Caleb Williams: Listed as full practice participant Wednesday
items.text:
Bears head coach Ben Johnson said that Williams (hamstring) will listed as a full practice participant on Wednesday's estimated injury report, Sean Hammond of the Chicago Tribune reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Michael Penix: Set for limited practice Wednesday
items.text:
Falcons head coach Kevin Stefanski said that Penix (ribs) will practice Wednesday but will be limited in some fashion, Marc Raimondi of ESPN.com reports.
